source: OECD International Transport and Insurance Costs of merchandise trade (ITIC)
endpoint: https://sdmx.oecd.org/sti-public/rest/data/OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_ITIC@DF_ITIC,1.1/  (NOTE: /sti-public/, not the documented /public/ - that path faults on this dataflow)
measure: C_F, CIF/FOB margin, unit PT_IM_CIF = percent of import CIF value
grain: REF_AREA = importer, COUNTERPART_AREA = exporter, COMM_HS2017 = HS2017 HEADING (4-digit; 6-digit returns 404), annual
obs_status_note: I = imputed by the gravity model; reported values are flagged differently. METHODOLOGY_TYPE ME = model estimate, AG = aggregate.
rate_limit_note: The OECD host returns HTTP 429 on the last one or two headings of a full run. Retrying those alone with backoff always succeeds - it is throughput, not a block. Recovered 8112 and 8505 this way.
